+++ b/app/pricing.py
@@ -25,7 +25,10 @@ def compute_total(order, coupon_code=None):
     taxable = subtotal - discount
     tax = round(taxable * GST_RATE, 2)
     item_count = sum(item["qty"] for item in order["items"])
-    average_item_price = round(subtotal / item_count, 2)
+    if item_count == 0:
+        average_item_price = 0
+    else:
+        average_item_price = round(subtotal / item_count, 2)

         "order_id": order["id"],
         "coupon": coupon_code.upper() if coupon_code else None,
